prompt: I have a messy Downloads folder containing some PDFs, JPG images, and installation files (DMG and PKG). Please organize the Downloads folder by creating these subfolders exactly as named: Work, Personal, Installers, Archive, ToSort. Move the PDFs to Work, images (JPG) to Personal, installers (DMG and PKG) to Installers. If a file matches an installer type (.dmg or .pkg), put it in Installers even if it is old; do not leave installer files in Archive. Move other non-installer files older than 3 months into Archive. Leave any remaining other files in ToSort. Files that do not match PDF, JPG, DMG, or PKG and are not old enough for Archive must end up in ToSort; for example, random.bin should be in ToSort, not left elsewhere. If ORGANIZATION_PLAN.md already exists, regenerate it for this run and overwrite it. Do not assume the Downloads folder is already correctly organized; verify the current placement and fix any mismatches before finishing. Please output your plan as a markdown file named ORGANIZATION_PLAN.md before making changes. Then apply the organization according to the plan.
